coverage: Regional report; numerical extraction remains incomplete.
report_note: The 2021 census used administrative data, supplemented by an ethnicity/language/religion survey and statistical estimation. The readable municipal table is a secondary transcription; the official methodology should accompany it.
regional_report: Visaginas: Russian 13,161, Lithuanian 3,853, Polish 1,016. Šalčininkai district: Polish 18,361, Russian 5,308, Lithuanian 4,968. Vilnius district: Polish 42,595, Lithuanian 36,077, Russian 12,595. Two-mother-tongue respondents are a separate column, so these individual columns are not inclusive language-ability totals.
